note: Pictures for the repair finder. 'models' maps a catalogue model (brand/slug) to a photo of exactly that model with its licence and author (shown as credit). Only freely licensed photos (e.g. Wikimedia Commons, CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC0 / public domain) or photos supplied with rights by the owner. 'rules' are the fallback: the first rule whose brand and pattern (regular expression, case-insensitive) match the model name gives a picture of the same series, labelled 'Symbolbild'. Without either, the neutral drawing is shown. Never point an entry at a picture of a different model.
